channel.description: Recent content in Openai.com/Blog on .NET Ramblings

item.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
item.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/the-full-stack-behind-abundant-intelligence

item.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
item.description: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/jalapeno-first-results

item.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
item.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/disrupting-malicious-uses-of-ai-influence-campaign-russia

item.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
item.description: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-admin-plugin

item.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro
item.description: GPT‑5.6 is now available in Kiro, helping developers plan, build, review, and test software with better price-performance. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-6-in-kiro

item.title: Introducing AI Futures
item.description: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/introducing-ai-futures

item.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
item.description: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/stampli

item.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
item.description: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/offering-zero-data-retention-for-frontier-models

item.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
item.description: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/replit

item.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
item.description: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/strengthening-democratic-oversight-in-national-security

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
item.description: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-teens

item.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
item.description: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/pacing-model-development-cyber-capabilities

item.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
item.description: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/partnering-with-codeai

item.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
item.description: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/asana

item.title: How NVIDIA scales expertise with ChatGPT Work
item.description: NVIDIA teams use ChatGPT Work to reduce manual tasks, connect fast-moving signals, and scale successful workflows globally. Link to article: https://openai.com/index/nvidia/chatgpt-work
